exposure: scheduled CS group vs. emergency CS group
cohort: Women diagnosed with PA over 3 years at 2 tertiary referral hospitals in China
finding: Women with a history of uterine curettage, cesarean section, or placenta previa are more likely to have PA, and scheduled cesarean sections are associated with better maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Maternal and neonatal outcomes were found to be better in scheduled cesarean sections compared to emergency cesarean sections for placenta accreta.
